Hi Chris —

Thanks again for the quick discovery earlier. Two quick things I want to lock down so we can get the technical run scheduled and scoped correctly:

1) Join path: you mentioned the invite didn’t arrive for your infra team. We’ve seen some corporate calendars drop external ICS if the vendor uses SSO redirects. I’ll paste a direct meeting URL in the next message and attach a short runbook.

2) Scope / attendees: you said Julia (infra) plus a backend eng and a security reviewer might join. Can you confirm who needs to see the KV-cache and quantization slides specifically? That determines whether we do the 60m demo (deep technical signals) vs 30m high-level.

Proposed slot windows (I’ll hold these on my calendar until you confirm):
- Option A: Thu Dec 16 — 09:00–10:00 PT / 12:00–13:00 ET / 18:00–19:00 CET
- Option B: Fri Dec 17 — 07:00–08:00 PT / 10:00–11:00 ET / 16:00–17:00 CET

If neither works, share 2/3 times that work for your team and I’ll sync Soojin to build a short mutual action plan.

Attachments: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf (2-page stub) — includes recommended prep steps and SSO calendar guidance.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182
https://redwood.ai

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the note. I didn’t receive the calendar invite from your team — our mailrelay often rejects ICS from external providers and sends them to a quarantine folder. That’s why Julia forwarded your original meeting link (which was blank).

Attendees: Julia (infra), I’ll ask Mark (platform) to join if the session is focused on latency/kv cache. We definitely need the 60m slot for the deep technical demo — Mark + our security reviewer will need to see how you handle data retention & audit logs.

Of the two slots you offered, Option B (Fri Dec 17 16:00 CET) would be best for us. If that’s your 07:00 PT slot, that’s doable but tight — can you also paste a direct meeting URL (not just ICS) in your reply so we can add it manually to our calendar?

Also: our security team requires that demo recordings be disabled by the vendor by default and that any shared artifacts include a short data-retention note. Can you include that in the agenda?

Chris Park
Head of Platform Integrations | HelioMed
chris.park@heliomed.com | +44 20 7946 0110
